public_messages: I’ll inspect the apparatus description, existing model, and tests; then derive the calibration/prediction logic, implement it, and run the public test suite.

The supplied predictor uses a local rescaling of a homogeneous Green operator. That violates compatibility through the bonded, laterally patterned coating, so I’m replacing it with a full plane-strain elasticity solve: Fourier modes in the patterned direction and a variational quadratic finite-element solve through the coating thickness. The fluid evolution will then use the resulting normal compliance with conserved mean gap displacement.
